title: Go: Microservice Architecture
description: Build a microservice architecture in Go with HTTP handlers, middleware, service discovery, and inter-service communication.

steps.title: HTTP service with health endpoint
steps.description: Create an HTTP server that listens on a configurable port. Add a `/health` endpoint returning JSON `{"status":"ok"}`. Add a `GET /api/version` returning `{"service":"user-service","version":"1.0.0"}`. Print each request using `fmt.Printf("[%s] %s %s\n", method, path, status)`.

verification.successMessage: HTTP service with health endpoint works!
verification.failureMessage: Print incoming requests with method, path, and status code.

steps.title: REST API with CRUD operations
steps.description: Add CRUD endpoints for a `User` resource: `POST /api/users`, `GET /api/users/:id`, `PUT /api/users/:id`, `DELETE /api/users/:id`. Use an in-memory map with `sync.RWMutex`. Print operations using `fmt.Printf("CRUD: %s %s\n", method, path)`.
hints: Parse path parameters manually or use a router
Use json.Decoder for request body parsing

verification.failureMessage: Print each CRUD operation with method and path.

steps.title: Middleware: logging and recovery
steps.description: Implement a logging middleware that records method, path, duration, and status code. Implement a recovery middleware that catches panics and returns 500. Wrap your handlers using `func(next http.Handler) http.Handler`. Print log entries using `fmt.Printf("LOG: %s %s (%dms)\n", method, path, ms)`.
hints: Use a ResponseWriter wrapper to capture status code

verification.failureMessage: Print log entries with method, path, and duration.

steps.title: Service registry and discovery
steps.description: Create a `ServiceRegistry` that stores `(name, url, healthy)` tuples. Implement `Register(name, url)`, `Deregister(name)`, `Discover(name)`, and `Heartbeat(name)`. Services send heartbeats every 5s (simulated with ticker). Print registry state using `fmt.Printf("Registry: %s -> %s (healthy: %v)\n", name, url, healthy)`.
hints: Service registry is a map of service info
Stale entries (no heartbeat in 15s) marked unhealthy

verification.failureMessage: Print registered services with their health status.

steps.title: Inter-service HTTP calls
steps.description: Create a client that discovers a service via the registry and makes an HTTP call to it. Implement retry with backoff (3 attempts, exponential delay). Handle service not found and request failures. Print results using `fmt.Printf("Call %s: status=%d, body=%s\n", service, status, body)`.
hints: Use net/http client for service calls
Circuit breaker pattern prevents cascading failures

verification.failureMessage: Print service call results with status and response body.

steps.title: Graceful shutdown
steps.description: Add graceful shutdown using `os.Signal` and `signal.Notify` for SIGINT and SIGTERM. Drain connections with `server.Shutdown(ctx)`. Print shutdown stages using `fmt.Printf("Shutdown: %s\n", stage)`.
hints: Context with timeout prevents hanging forever

verification.failureMessage: Print each stage of the shutdown process.
